camel_example: aliyun cas ListCertWarehouse --region cn-hangzhou --Type aliyunPCA --InstanceId 14dcc8afc7578e1f --CurrentPage 1 --ShowSize 50 --Name name
description_en: Queries the certificate application repositories in your account
description_zh: 本接口一般用于查询证书仓库列表
kebab_example: aliyun cas list-cert-warehouse --name name --instance-id 14dcc8afc7578e1f --type aliyunPCA --current-page 1 --show-size 50 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCertWarehouse

parameters.help_en: The name of the certificate application repository. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 仓库名称，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the certificate application repository
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the certificate application repository. Valid values:

ssl: certificate application repository of SSL certificates

uploadPCA: certificate application repository of uploaded private certificates

free: certificate application repository of free certificates, available only on the China site (aliyun.com)

aliyunPCA: certificate application repository of private certificates purchased from Alibaba Cloud Private Certificate Authority (PCA), available only on the China site (aliyun.com)

disable: disabled certificate application repository
parameters.help_zh:
仓库类型，取值：

**uploadCA **：上传的CA证书，即包含完整证书链的CA证书。
**uploadPCA **：上传的证书，包括自签证书、第三方签发的证书或阿里云签发的证书等。
**aliyunPCA **：阿里云PCA证书
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页，每页展示数据大小，默认50
parameters.name: show_size
